purpose: Necromantic building technology icons matched to existing game icon scale, with soft violet atmospheric backdrops, transparent outer edges, and no borders, fan blades or pointed ornaments.

game_export.outer_background: soft dark-plum/violet backdrop fading to transparent outer edges; no metallic frame
game_export.artwork_fit: Uniform aspect-preserving fit within 64x64, centered on 72x72 canvas. Visible width 64px for each export.

icons.prompt: Precise-object-edit / game UI asset matching. Image 1 is the current BORDERLESS CRYPT technology icon; retain its actual low wide building design with smooth curved roof, flat side caps, arched closed skull door, round lower door detail and short steps. Image 2 is the EXISTING GAME TECHNOLOGY ICON STYLE AND BACKGROUND REFERENCE. The user requests matching the rest of the icon sizes and adding some background. Compose image 1's building on a compact SOFT VIOLET BACKDROP like image 2: a dark plum near-round field with subtle cloudy texture, muted lavender light directly behind the crypt, wispy feathered edges fading smoothly to actual transparency. The background is a supporting magical atmosphere, NOT a border or frame. No gold ring, no metallic border, no ornamental circle outline, no sharp edge around the field. The complete icon should occupy a roughly square footprint, with background filling out above the squat building. The crypt itself should occupy about 82% of the width of that soft purple field and sit in its middle/lower portion, with enough breathing room on both sides; do not stretch the building taller. Keep stone body opaque and original materials. Make a restrained pale violet rim light separate the roof and flat caps from the background, with shallow shadow under the steps. All edges, materials and broad highlights should match the hand-painted miniature game-icon quality of image 2; clean readability after 72x72 export. The entire combined subject and aura must fit within a roughly 64x64 visible footprint on a 72x72 transparent canvas when downscaled, evenly centred with safe margins. No extra objects or face from image 2, no text. Preserve NO SPIKES: no rays, blade fans, pyramids, sharp finials or new roof ornaments. The outermost backdrop perimeter fades to genuine transparency, not black or an opaque square. ONE square icon.

Precise-object-edit / matching game UI asset. Image 1 is the CURRENT BORDERLESS RITUAL DAIS building to retain. Image 2 supplies the new matched background and scale treatment for the pair.
